violations.text: Raw animal foods (liquid eggs) were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods (butter, cream) in the walk-in refrigerator. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/02/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (can opener) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 11/02/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (ice machine) was observed with a orange biofilm. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. See disposal. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 11/02/2026
Tomato soup, which was prepared in advance, was not cooled to 70 degrees Fahrenheit in 2 hours and then to 41 degrees Fahrenheit within 4 hours. See disposal. New Violation. Correct By: 11/02/2026

Sauces were observed not marked with the date of preparation. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/02/2026

Observed establishment vacuum packaging (cooked duck) on-site without prior approval from RIDOH CFP. Establishment must discontinue vacuum packaging until the procedures have been submitted to and approved by RIDOH CFP. See disposal. New Violation. Correct By: 11/02/2026

Working containers of nuts are not labeled with the common name of the food. Working containers holding food or food ingredients that are removed from their original packages, such as flour, herbs, salt, sugar, and spices must be labeled with the common name of the food. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/02/2026

Bowls are being used as scoops in containers of flour. Utensils used to dispense non-time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods such as sugar and flour must be stored in the food item with their handles above the top of the food within the container. New Violation. Correct By: 11/02/2026
Prep unit door gaskets were observed torn and in poor repair. New Violation. Correct By: 11/16/2026
The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the quaternary ammonium sanitizing solution for the dishwasher. New Violation. Correct By: 11/02/2026
Inspector observed leak at 3 bay sink faucet. Plumbing to me maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 11/16/2026

The wall in the warewashing area has an accumulation of soil residue and food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 11/02/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (ice machine) was observed with an accumulation brown biofilm. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. New Violation. Correct By: 07/31/2025

The food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils were not sanitized at the bar. The required utensil surface temperature of 160 degrees Fahrenheit was not achieved during the sanitizing cycle of the dishwasher as evidenced by the failure of the thermolabel (temperature indicator) affixed to the surface of a utensil to turn black. PIC called for service at time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/31/2025

The sink and surface concentration in the sanitizing solution dispenser of the mop sink was 0 parts per million (ppm). The concentration of lactic acid in the sanitizing solution must be between 0.27-0.55 ppm. PIC manually added, called for service at time of inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 07/31/2025
